sources.source_and_scope: Alexei Yurchak, *Everything Was Forever, Until It Was No More*, publisher [chapter 1 PDF](https://assets.press.princeton.edu/chapters/s8102.pdf), printed pp25–27 / PDF pp25–27, text extraction
sources.finding_and_boundary: The shift toward reproducing authoritative forms is explicitly described as unplanned; it can enable new meanings. It is not simply universal sincere belief in a fabricated world. Primary theoretical account; no full-book review.
Documents the connection between Yurchak’s book and Curtis’s film. Establishes reception, not equivalence of their explanatory methods.

sources.source_and_scope: Adam Curtis interview with Nick Bradshaw, [BFI/Sight and Sound](https://www.bfi.org.uk/sight-and-sound/interviews/adam-curtis-cant-get-your-out-head-art-lost-way), culture/smokescreen and visual-journalism passages
sources.finding_and_boundary: Curtis describes mixing journalism with visual sensibility and questions culture’s claimed radical efficacy. Attributed interpretation, not proof that all opposition is managed. This is a 2021 interview, not direct viewing of the 2016 film.

sources.source_and_scope: Royal Television Society, [film announcement](https://rts.org.uk/article/new-adam-curtis-film-hypernormalisation-comes-iplayer), search-index excerpt only; direct page403
sources.finding_and_boundary: Summarizes Curtis’s simplified-world thesis. Secondary description only. No film timecodes or complete film audit supplied; BBC access blocked.

sources.source_and_scope: Nathan J. Russell, [Mackinac introduction, 4 Jan2006](https://www.mackinac.org/7504), issue-spectrum paragraphs and editorial note
sources.finding_and_boundary: Acceptability constrains which policy proposals are politically feasible. Institutional retrospective explanation of Overton’s model, not an original signed Joseph Overton article. The page identifies itself as the earliest general-audience Mackinac article, not the earliest conceivable occurrence.

sources.source_and_scope: McCombs & Shaw1972, [research article PDF](https://fbaum.unc.edu/teaching/articles/POQ-1972-McCOMBS-176-87.pdf), pp176–179 / PDF1–4, introduction and method text
sources.finding_and_boundary: Agenda salience differs from changing belief. The Chapel Hill design used100 undecided voters and media-content comparison. This supports an attention lens, not a universal causal effect or modern-platform effect estimate. Tables not visually checked.

sources.source_and_scope: Robert Entman1993, [publisher record](https://academic.oup.com/joc/article-abstract/43/4/51/4160153?login=false), bibliographic/search record; university PDF inaccessible as readable text
sources.finding_and_boundary: *Framing: Toward Clarification of a Fractured Paradigm*, pp51–58, DOI10.1111/j.1460-2466.1993.tb01304.x. Follow-up source, not a newly completed full-text validation.

sources.source_and_scope: Machiavelli, *The Prince*, W.K. Marriott translation at [Fordham](https://sourcebooks.web.fordham.edu/basis/machiavelli-prince.asp), chaptersXVII–XIX, especiallyXVIII
sources.finding_and_boundary: Distinguishes appearance, promises and practical action; also warns against hatred and insecure power. Normative strategic writing, not an empirical algorithm that deception always succeeds. Gutenberg URLs failed; Fordham replacement was actually read.

sources.source_and_scope: Sun Tzu, Lionel Giles translation, [MIT text](https://classics.mit.edu/Tzu/artwar.html), I18–26, II1–7, XIII1–7 and14–27
sources.finding_and_boundary: Deception sits beside costs, preparation and human intelligence. Do not reduce the work to a license for omnipotent manipulation. Translation-level reading, no Chinese textual comparison.

sources.source_and_scope: Hegel, [Encyclopaedia Logic, Doctrine of Being](https://www.marxists.org/reference/archive/hegel/works/sl/slbeing.htm), §§84–86, English transcription
sources.finding_and_boundary: Logical determination and transition concern concepts; this passage is not a manufactured-crisis manual. Primary philosophical text in translation. No claim to search every Hegel work for a phrase.

sources.source_and_scope: Julie Maybee, [Stanford Encyclopedia, Hegel’s Dialectics](https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/hegel-dialectics/), section1 with §§79–82 citations
sources.finding_and_boundary: Explains understanding, dialectical and speculative moments and the preserve/negate double sense of Aufhebung. “Problem → Reaction → Solution” should not be quoted as Hegel’s formulation on this evidence. Authoritative secondary interpretation.

sources.source_and_scope: JCS memorandum13March1962, [National Security Archive record](https://nsarchive.gwu.edu/CMC-60/joint-chiefs-pretexts-to-invade-Cuba-1962), [original-document OCR](https://nsarchive.gwu.edu/media/29095/ocr), opening recommendation and Annex printed7–10
sources.finding_and_boundary: Lemnitzer’s memorandum forwards proposed fabricated pretexts for planning, with individual projects to be considered separately. This documents a proposal and proposed false attribution, **not execution** or a universal template for later events. OCR read; scan-image verification not completed.

The institution acknowledges infiltration, disruption and discrediting even with little or no evidence of illegality, and April1971 termination. Retrospective institutional account, including self-defensive framing; not a read-through of every operational file.
Concrete primary-file discovery route: New Left, Black Extremist, Hoodwink, Cuba and other collections. Index only; no specific forged letter or attack proven by merely finding a collection.

sources.source_and_scope: Michael Warner, [CIA Studies in Intelligence: Congress for Cultural Freedom origins](https://www.cia.gov/resources/csi/studies-in-intelligence/archives/vol-38-no-5/origins-of-the-congress-for-cultural-freedom-1949-1950/), introductory history
sources.finding_and_boundary: CIA institutional history acknowledges sponsorship and describes journals/conferences. Its favorable effectiveness judgment remains the institution’s interpretation. Financing does not demonstrate each contributor’s knowledge or agreement.

Report records Johnson’s29March1967 approval of ending covert support to US educational/private voluntary organizations and says termination completed by year-end. Distinguishes concealed funding from activities themselves; not proof all later support vanished.

Records MKULTRA financing/research background and an intelligence-source disclosure dispute. The legal ruling concerns withholding identities; it neither scientifically validates mind control nor establishes “Monarch” continuity.

ACT describes an exploratory concept addressing cognition, civil-military cooperation and resilience. Declared objectives are evidence of institutional framing, not demonstrated effectiveness or secret ownership of unrelated NGOs.

coverage.scope: Selected original and institutional text passages, scholarly framing, not whole upstream research brief
